dimensions.assessment: Directly involves federal officials, advisory committee members from various private sector industries, and stakeholders interested in blockchain technology.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary shall serve as a principal advisor to the President for policy pertaining to the deployment, use, application, and competitiveness of blockchain technology

dimensions.assessment: Effects are primarily advisory, coordination, and administrative, as participation and adoption by private entities remain voluntary.
dimensions.evidence: Nothing in this section may be construed-- (1) to require a private entity to share information with the Secretary; ... (4) to require the adoption of the best practices described in subsection (d).

dimensions.assessment: The source text does not specify explicit federal spending amounts or budget authorizations.
Creates a new advisory committee within the Department of Commerce and mandates reports, best practices compendiums, and federal coordination activities.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary shall, in consultation with the heads of relevant Federal agencies, establish an advisory committee to support the adoption of blockchain technology

dimensions.assessment: Establishes an advisory committee with a scheduled termination date of seven years after enactment, alongside ongoing reporting requirements.
dimensions.evidence: The Advisory Committee shall terminate on the date that is 7 years after the date of the enactment of this Act.

missing_information: Specific appropriations or funding amounts required to execute the act.
importance_detail.rationale: Establishes advisory committees and Department of Commerce advisory functions to support blockchain technology deployment, competitiveness, and best practices.
